text: Implemented typed compressed ReducedRankGls inference scope. DenseFitBlockResult and DenseFmriFitResult now carry CoefficientInferenceScope, defaulting to All for ordinary dense engines. T/F contrast evaluation validates weights against that scope after name resolution. Compressed RRG projections set scope to the event/target columns, so task contrasts remain estimable while nuisance/baseline contrasts return NonEstimableContrast instead of generic dense statistics. Chunked dense merge now preserves and checks identical inference scopes. Updated fit README. Evidence: sbt fitJVM/test passed 127/127; sbt fitJS/test passed 122/122; git diff --check clean on touched paths; trailing-whitespace scan clean. Remaining on this child: bootstrap SE policy for reduced-rank results and voxelwise-AR compressed RRG.
